meta.how_to_read: observed = what the Astryx file does today. our_rule = what a project built from this reference must do (Web_Design_System_Skill wins). When they differ, the project copy is fixed (Fix on create).

observed.focus: Inputs: Input Ring/* inner shadow 3px. Buttons: 1px Core/Accent stroke, invisible on Primary
observed.disabled: variant look at 50% opacity (matches our rule)

accessibility.our_rule: border/input >= 3:1, placeholder and muted text >= 4.5:1, focus-ring / focus-ring-offset effect styles, every surface bound to a Semantic token so Dark works

observed.collections: Color (Neutral Light / Neutral Dark), 108 variables, raw hex, ALL_SCOPES, no descriptions, no code syntax
observed.primitives: none in Figma; code has an OKLCH palette with stops 0-100 by 5 and a dark chroma taper
role_groups: Blue..Yellow hue families (Background, Border, Icon, Text)
observed.themes: Figma extended collections of Color, Radius and Typography: Chocolate, Butter, Stone, Y2K, Gothic, Matcha (90 color overrides each)

our_rule.primitive_ramp_suggestion: OKLCH ramps with steps 0-100 by 5 (Astryx code) or our 0-950 Tailwind steps; pick one per project and record it
our_rule.multi_brand: base Semantic collection + one Figma extended collection per brand (Astryx pattern), only after the user approves

spacing.observed: Spacing/0, half 2, 1 4, 1-half 6, 2 8 ... 12 48 (n x 4px); 72% of component padding and gap values bound, 2,677 raw
spacing.our_rule: every padding and gap bound to space/*

size.observed: Size/Element/Small 28, Medium 32, Large 36: control heights bound on Button and inputs (SM, MD, LG)
size.lesson: a Size collection for control heights keeps every control on the same 3 heights

radius.observed: Radius/None 4, Inner 6, Element 10, Container 12, Page 28, Full 9999 (role names, not t-shirt sizes); 86% bound

usage.None: sections, headers, dividers (but the value is 4)

radius.our_rule: radius/{none 0, sm, base, md, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, full}; role names may be added as Semantic aliases if the project wants them

border_width.observed: Border Width 1 exists; 8 of 807 component strokes bound

observed.families: Figtree (Heading, Body), JetBrains Mono (Code); variables hold CSS font stacks, not bindable

typography.our_rule: bind family, weight, size, line height and letter spacing; Desktop / iPad / Mobile modes; body never below 16px on mobile

observed.wrapper: Icon set Size xsm 12, sm 16, md 20, lg 24

icons.our_rule: Icon/<Title Case Name> or keep the Lucide names consistently; color bound to icon tokens; every icon in a component exposed as an instance swap

observed.naming: Category-free names (Button, TextInput) and Family / Part (Tabs / .Tab); `.` prefix marks internal parts
observed.properties: variant axes for State, Size, Variant; booleans for optional parts; native SLOT properties for content areas (74 slots); property names mix Title Case and React camelCase
observed.descriptions: 40 of 131 components; the good ones list anatomy, axes, token names and the code path

our_rule.naming: Category / Component, Title Case properties and values, no abbreviations
our_rule.descriptions: Purpose, Usage Rules, Accessibility on every component
our_rule.dark_mode: switch the Color mode on the frame; never duplicate components
our_rule.bound: fills, strokes, padding, gap, radius, text styles, effect styles: 100% bound, 0 remote

off_limits.note: Read only. This is Abdul's duplicate of the Astryx community file; its content is synced from code by the Astryx agent upstream. Never write to it; fixes go into a project copy. The full prohibition list is the default Web reference's rules.json > off_limits.rules (ds-auditor applies it to every project).
